event: Khavda complex generating at its ceiling
Phase-to-ground fault on 400 kV Indore-Asoj line; inverters ride through
0.45 Hz voltage oscillation develops across the complex
First of three voltage dips below the ride-through threshold
Voltage sags to 680 kV for 5 seconds; reactive power ramps 145 to 900 MVAr
About 2931 MW of generation trips on over-voltage protection
17 EHV lines tripped; whole complex blacked out; frequency falls
